title: Personalized Coconut for Weddings – Everything You Need to Know
excerpt: A complete guide to personalized coconuts for weddings — designs, minimum order, freshness, delivery and how to book across India.

content.text: Personalized coconuts have become a signature welcome experience at Indian weddings. Here is everything you need to know before booking.
What is a personalized coconut?
It is a fresh A+ grade tender coconut, custom-engraved with names, your wedding hashtag, date or a floral motif, and served chilled with a straw.
Minimum order and booking
The typical minimum order is 100 coconuts. We recommend booking 15–20 days in advance for the best customization.
Freshness and delivery
Every coconut is handpicked, delivered chilled, and available pan-India — including destination-wedding hubs like Udaipur, Goa and Jaipur.
